procedural_matters: SUI 1808 was represented by Lorentz Kausche.
FRA 397 was represented by Lilou Ruat.
Prior to the hearing, an arbitration meeting was held; Anastazja Lewandowska (member of the international jury) acted as arbitrator.
SUI 1808 did not ask to withdraw the protest after the arbitration meeting and neither boat took a Post-Race Penalty under RRS T1(a).
Julia d’Amodo (crew of FRA 397) attended the hearing as an observer.
The international jury provided video evidence.
The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident were 6 knots of wind and no waves.
20 seconds before the starting signal, SUI 1808 was sailing on starboard tack towards the race committee signal vessel on a close-hauled course at a speed of 1.5 knots.
FRA 397 was also approaching the starting line on starboard tack, clear astern of SUI 1808.
FRA 397, sailing faster, established an overlap to windward of SUI 1808.
FRA 397 bore away and passed SUI 1808 on the windward side at a distance of less than 10 cm.
conclusions: FRA 397 to windward failed to keep clear of SUI 1808 to leeward, and broke RRS 11. See Definition Keep Clear (b).
